effect_description_eng:
＜Barrier＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted in battle, by trashing the top card of your security stack, prevent that deletion.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may link 1 level 4 or lower Digimon card from your trash or this Digimon's digivolution cards to this Digimon without paying the cost.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon gets linked, if you have 5 or fewer security cards, ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞ (Place the top card of your deck on top of your security stack.) Then, to 1 of your opponent's Digimon, give -1000 DP until their turn ends for each of your security cards.
